title: Pacer
attribution: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth Wiki contributors

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Pacers wander around the room aimlessly and can be spawned when a Gaper, a Flaming Gaper or a Frowning Gaper is killed.

sections.heading: Gusher
sections.text: Gushers wander around a room aimlessly, similar to Pacers, but will occasionally shoot a short ranged slow-moving, blood shot in whichever direction they happen to be moving in. They can be spawned from all the same sources as the Pacer with the addition of Lepers which will always spawn a grey-colored Gusher upon death.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • Pure Magenta Champion Gushers will spit two blood shots at different intervals.

sections.heading: Splasher
sections.text:
Splashers wander around a room and randomly shoot Ipecac shots.
They can be spawned when a Gurgle is killed.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: • [Before Repentance] Splashers that are spawned from Champion Gurgles appear as Champions but Splashers that spawn naturally in layouts are never seen in champion form, even if using the "CHAM P1ON" special seed.

sections.heading: Black Globin's Body
sections.text: Black Globin's Bodies walk around aimlessly, occasionally spawning a Spider. They can be spawned alongside a Black Globin's Head when a Black Globin is killed.

sections.heading: Level 2 Gusher
sections.text: Level 2 Gushers run around a room blindly, occasionally spitting up Small Maggots.
